title: Notice of Formal Performance and Suitability Reviews
summary: Formal performance and suitability reviews: what they are and how they will work.
body:
Since opening, we have worked hard to establish what Pelagos stands for. As we move into the next phase of our operations, we must keep a high standard of excellence and accountability in every department.

To make sure we are meeting our operational goals and giving guests the level of service they expect, formal performance reviews will be held over the coming weeks. These reviews are a standard requirement under your signed employment contract. Their purpose is to formally assess your current performance and your ongoing suitability for your position.

### How the reviews will work

- **Manager-led:** your line manager will conduct your review. They will assess your output, your technical skills and how well you meet the standards in your job description and our SOPs.
- **Suitability:** we will look at how each team member’s work matches our brand values and the long-term needs of the role, so that every role is done at the level of professionalism we need.
- **Your input:** you will have the chance to comment on your review and raise any support or training you need.

This is a formal assessment, but it is also an important tool for your development. It will show where you are doing well and where improvement is needed, so that everyone in the team is set up to succeed in their role.

Your line manager will give you a date and time for your review.

Thank you for your continued commitment to the standards we are building together.

Thank you for your cooperation.
